ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 1) Which period is known as The Age of Chaucer?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
1066 - 1340 : Anglo-Norman Period.
1340 - 1400 : Age of Chaucer.
1400 - 1485 : Barren Age.
1500 - 1558 : Preparation for Renaissance.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 2) The Caroline Period belongs to -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Caroline age belongs to ''The Renaissance Period''.
It was named after the King Charles - I who reigned England from 1625 to 1649.
The Renaissance Period has four parts -
The Elizabethan Period -- 1558 - 1603
The Jacobean Period -- 1603 - 1625
The Caroline Period -- 1625 - 1649
- The Commonwealth Period -- 1649 - 1660
Source: Live MCQ lecture

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 3) Which literary work is considered as the First Monument in English Literature?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Beowulf, heroic poem, the highest achievement of Old English literature(England) and the earliest European vernacular epic.
It is also the first monument in English literature.

Major literary works of The Anglo-Saxon Period:
The Wanderer, The Seafarer, the Husband's Message, and The Wife's Lament.

'The Anglo-Saxon Chronicle' written in this age is the earliest prose of English literature.

[Source: Encyclopaedia Britannica and An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 4) Who is known as the Father of English Modern Poetry?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Geoffrey Chaucer is the Father of English Modern Poetry.
His best writing is Canterbury Tales.
He is also called -
- Father of English Language,
- Father of English literature,
- First Humourist in English Literature,
- The First great Modernist.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 5) The Divine Comedy is a -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
The Divine Comedy, Italian La divina commedia, original name La commedia, long narrative poem written in Italian circa 1308–21 by Dante.
It is usually held to be one of the world’s great works of literature.
source: britannica

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 6) Renaissance began in -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
The Renaissance Age (1500 - 1660) Literary Features:
Originated in Italy (Florence City).
- Renaissance spirit was the main force that characterized the literature of this age.
Major Features:
i) Aestheticism.
ii) Humanism.
iii) Nationalism.
iv) Spirit of Adventure.
Source: LiveMCQ Lecture

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 7) Which one was the first play by Christopher Marlowe?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Tamburlaine the Great, first play by Christopher Marlowe, produced about 1587 and published in 1590.
The play was written in two parts, each of which has five acts, and was based on the earlier Silva de varia lección (1540; The Foreste; or, Collection of Histories) by the early 16th-century Spanish scholar and humanist Pedro Mexía.
Source: britannica

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 8) The act of giving a human characteristics to something which is not human is called-
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Personification, figure of speech in which human characteristics are attributed to an abstract quality, animal, or inanimate object.
An example is “The Moon doth with delight / Look round her when the heavens are bare” (William Wordsworth, “Ode: Intimations of Immortality from Recollections of Early Childhood,” 1807).
Another is “Death lays his icy hand on kings” (James Shirley, “The Glories of Our Blood and State,” 1659).
Source: britannica

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 9) Who wrote the epic ‘The Faerie Queene’?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
The Faerie Queene, one of the great long poems in the English language, written in the 16th century by Edmund Spenser.
Edmund Spenser is known as the poet of poets in English Literature.
Source: britannica and Live MCQ Lecture

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 10) ‘Ralph Roister Doister’ was written by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Nicholas Udall, English playwright, translator, and schoolmaster who wrote the first known English comedy, Ralph Roister Doister.
Source: Britannica

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 11) “Some books are to be tasted, others to be swallowed and some few to be chewed and digested.” - this quotation is by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
''Some books are to be tasted, others to be swallowed, and some few to be chewed and digested.''
- The quote is taken from - Essays by Francis Bacon.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 12) ‘Mosca’ is a character created by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
'Mosca' is an important character in the play Volpone by Ben Johnson.
Other important characters are: Volpone, Celia, Bonario, Corvino, Voltore.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 13) ‘The Duchess of Malfi’ was written by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
The Duchess of Malfi, five-act tragedy by English dramatist John Webster, performed 1613/14 and published in 1623.
Written after William Shakespeare had completed his final play, The Duchess of Malfi is regarded as the last great Elizabethan tragedy.
Source: britannica

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 14) How many sonnets were written by William Shakespeare?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
William Shakespeare is the greatest English dramatist.
He was born on 23 April, 1564 AD and died on 23 April, 1616 AD.
His Birth place is Stratford Avon. He is often called the bard of Avon.
Shakespearean period belongs to '1590-1616'.
He wrote 37 plays and 154 sonnets.
Source: Encyclopedia of Britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 15) “Brevity is the soul of wit” - is a famous quotation from shakespeare’s play -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
- ''Brevity is the soul of wit.''
- “Listen to many, speak to a few.”
- ''There is nothing either good or bad, but thinking makes it so.''
- ''To be, or not to be that is the question.''
Source: Hamlet, William Shakespeare

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 16) Who was the heroine character in Shakespeare’s play Othello?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Othello is a famous Tragedy of William Shakespeare.
The important characters of Othello are - Othello, Desdemona, Brabantio, lago, Cassio, Emilia etc.

Desdemona was the heroine character. She was Othello's wife and Brabantio's daughter.

'Desdemona' is also a play by Toni Morrison.

Source: Britannica and Live MCQ archive

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 17) Which one is the last work by William Shakespeare?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.option2: খ) The Taming of the Shrew
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
William Shakespeare is the greatest English dramatist. He is mostly known for his plays. His last work is The Tempest.

His famous comedies are As You Like It, The Comedy of Errors, Twelfth Night, The Taming of the Shrew, Mid Summer Night's Dream, The Tempest, The Two Gentleman of Verona, The Merry Wives of Windsor, The Winter's Tale, Cymbeline, Pericles, Prince of Tyre, The Two Nobel Kinsman, Much Ado About Nothing, Love's Labours Lost.

His famous Tragedies are Hamlet, Macbeth, Othello, King Lear, Julius Caesar, Romeo and Juliet, Antony and Cleopatra, Titus Andronicus, Timon of Athens.

Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 18) Who is a University Wit?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
University Wits:
Elizabethan Period - এর একদল নাট্যকার (Dramatist) - কে একত্রে University Wits বলা হয়।
এই নাট্যকারদের প্রায় সবাই Oxford বা Cambridge University এর গ্রাজুয়েট। তারা তাদের লেখনীতে গতানুগতিক ধারা পরিহার করে বৈচিত্র্য ও সমসাময়িক আধুনিকতা আনয়ন করেন।

University Wits - রা হচ্ছেনঃ
1. Christopher Marlowe - (Cambridge)
2. Robert Greene - (Cambridge)
3. Thomas Nashe - (Cambridge)
4. Thomas Lodge - (Oxford)
5. George Peele- (Oxford)
6. John Lyly - (Oxford)
7. Thomas Kyd (not university-trained)

Source: Britannica.com

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 19) 'The Sun Rising' is a Famous poem by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
John Donne is The Father of Metaphysical Poetry. He is called the Poet of Love.
His famous poems are The Good Morrow, The Sun Rising, The Canonization, Twicknam Garden, For Whom The Bell Tolls, etc.
Source: Live MCQ lecture.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 20) Which one is a famous poem by S.T. Coleridge?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.option2: খ) The Rime of the Ancient Mariner
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Samuel Taylor Coleridge (1772 - 1834):
Major works: Biographia Literaria (1833)(prose), The Rime of Ancient Mariner (1798), Kubla Khan, Christabel, ode on Dejection.
Source: Live MCQ lecture

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 21) “I wonder, by my troth, what thou and I Did, till we loved?” - who wrote this line?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
I wonder, by my troth, what thou and I
Did, till we loved? Were we not weaned till then?
But sucked on country pleasures, childishly?
Or snorted we in the Seven Sleepers’ den?
’Twas so; but this, all pleasures fancies be.
If ever any beauty I did see,
Which I desired, and got, ’twas but a dream of thee.

--The Good-Morrow by John Donne

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 22) Who wrote the poem ‘To Daffodils’?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
‘To Daffodils’ was written by - Robert Herrick.
‘The Daffodils’ was written by - William Wordsworth.
‘Daffodils’ was written by - Ted Hughes.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 23) ‘Paradise Lost’ and ‘Paradise Regained’ were two -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
John Milton is known as an Epic poet.
His famous Epic - Paradise Lost and Paradise Regained.
Source: Live MCQ lecture

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 24) “Death is the golden key that opens the place of eternity.” - Who said this?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
“Death is the golden key that opens the place of eternity.” - অর্থাৎ, “মৃত্যুর মাধ্যমে মানুষ অমরত্ব লাভ করে।”
- উক্তিটির স্রষ্টা John Milton
Source: Live MCQ archive

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 25) Who is known as the Father of Modern English Criticism?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
John Dryden is the Father of Modern English Criticism.

His famous works are - All for Love, The Indian Emperor, Aureng-Zebe, The Mistaken Husband, Absalom and Achitophel, MacFlecknoe, The essay of Dramatic Poesy, The Conquest of Granada, The Medal of John Bays.

Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ lecture.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 26) Who is the author of the famous book ‘Sherlock Holmes’?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Sherlock Holmes, fictional character created by the Scottish writer Arthur Conan Doyle.
The prototype for the modern mastermind detective, Holmes first appeared in Conan Doyle’s A Study in Scarlet, published in Beeton’s Christmas Annual of 1887.
source: britannica

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 27) Who is the author of the famous epic ‘The Rape of the Lock’?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
- Alexander Pope is a poet of Augustan Period.
- 'The Rape of the Lock' is a famous Epic of Alexander Pope.
- Baron (hero), Belinda (heroine), Arial (God) are the important character of 'The Rape of the Lock'.
Source: The Rape of the Lock.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 28) Which literary term best suits ‘Gulliver's Travels’?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Gulliver’s Travels, original title Travels into Several Remote Nations of the World, four-part satirical work by Anglo-Irish author Jonathan Swift, published anonymously in 1726 as Travels into Several Remote Nations of the World.
Source: Britannica

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 29) Which one is not a novel by Henry Fielding?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Henry Fielding regarded as 'Father of English Novel'.
His famous Novels are - Tom Jones, Amelia, Joseph Andrews, Jonathan Wilde, Top Secret.
His famous plays are - Rape Upon Rape, The Temple Beau, The Tragedy of Tragedies, The Modern Husband.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 30) ‘Elegy Written in a Country Churchyard’ was written by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
An Elegy Written in a Country Church Yard, meditative poem written in iambic pentameter quatrains by Thomas Gray, published in 1751.
Source: Encyclopaedia Britannica

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 31) “Charity begins at home and justice begins next door.” - who told this?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Charles Dickens, was an English novelist, generally considered the greatest of the Victorian era.
His famous quote - ''Charity begins at home, and justice begins next door.''
Source: Britannica

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 32) Which poem was written by William Wordsworth?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.option3: গ) I wandered Lonely as a Cloud
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
William Wordsworth's famous poems are - Lucy Poem, Lyrical Ballad, The Prelude, Poems in Two Volumes, The Excursion, The Daffodils, Tintern Abbey, The Solitary Reaper, Ode to Duty, Ode to on Intimations of Immortality, I wandered Lonely as a Cloud etc.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 33) “Poetry is the breath and finer spirit of knowledge.” - this quotation is by -

William Wordsworth is a famous Romantic poet.
Famous quotes of Wordsworth:
- Child is the father of man.
- Our birth is but a sleep and a forgetting.
- Nature never did betray the heart that loved her.
- Poetry is a spontaneous overflow of powerful feelings.
- Poetry is the breath and finer spirit of knowledge.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 34) Biographia Literaria is a famous book by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Biographia Literaria, in full Biographia Literaria; or Biographical Sketches of My Literary Life and Opinions, work by Samuel Taylor Coleridge, published in two volumes in 1817.
Source: Encyclopaedia Britannica

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 35) ‘The House of Fame’ was written by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
The House of Fame, a poem of more than 2,000 lines, also in dream-vision form. It is written by Geoffrey Chaucer.
His other famous poetry:
- The Book of the Duchess,
- The Legend of Good Women,
- The Parliament of Fowls,
- The Canterbury Tales, etc.
Source: Encyclopaedia Britannica

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question:
36) If winter comes
Can spring be far behind?
- This Verses are from -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.option2: খ) Ode to the West Wind
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Scatter, as from an unextinguish'd hearth

Be through my lips to unawaken'd earth

Source: poetryfoundation.org

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 37) ‘Ode to a Nightingale’ was written by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Ode to a Nightingale, poem in eight stanzas by John Keats, published in Lamia, Isabella, The Eve of St. Agnes, and Other Poems (1820).
It is a meditation upon art and life inspired by the song of a nightingale that has made a nest in the poet’s garden.
Source: Britannica

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 38) Who was both poet and painter?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
An English poet, painter and printmaker, William Blake was the precursor of the English Romanticism.
He was both a poet and a painter.
He is most remembered for his collection of poems titled Songs of Innocence and of Experience.
Source: Live MCQ lecture and Encyclopedia Britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 39) ‘Don Juan’, written by Lord Byron, is a/an -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
George Gordon Byron / Lord Byron (1788–1824):
This English poet revolts against existing social customs and norms. So that he is called ''The Rebel Poet''.
Famous books of Byron: The Vision of Judgement, Hours of Idleness, Heaven and Earth.
Famous poem: Childe Harold's Pilgrimage.
Don Juan is a satiric poem by Lord Byron.
Source: Source: Britannica and LiveMCQ Lecture.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 40) Which novel is written by Jane Austen?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Jane Austen is called an anti-romantic novelist in the romantic age because of her stern attitude against youthful passion.
Her famous novels: Pride and Prejudice, Sense and Sensibility, Mansfield Park, Emma, Persuasion etc.
Source: Britannica.com

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 41) Who is called the ‘poet of beauty’?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
John Keats is called the Poet of Beauty.
His famous works: Endymion, Hyperion, Lamia, Ode to a Nightingale, Ode to Autumn, The Eve of St. Agnes etc.
Source: Live McQ lecture

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 43) In the novel ‘A Tale of Two Cities’ the two cities are -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
A Tale of Two Cities is a novel by Charles Dickens. The story is set in the late 18th century against the background of the French Revolution.
The novel depicts the sprawling tale of London and revolutionary Paris.
Source: Britannica

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 44) ‘My Childhood’ is a novel written by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Maxim Gorky(1868-1936):
Russian-Soviet writer who wrote stories, novels, and plays.
His notable works: Mother, My Childhood, In the World, The Lower Depths etc.
Source:Live MCQ Lecture and Encyclopaedia Britannica

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 45) Who wrote the novel ‘Vanity Fair’?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Vanity Fair, novel of early 19th-century English society by William Makepeace Thackeray, published serially in monthly installments from 1847 to 1848 and in book form in 1848.
Thackeray's previous writings had been published either unsigned or under pseudonyms; Vanity Fair was the first work he published under his own name. It is subtitled A Novel Without a Hero, Vanity Fair metaphorically represents the human condition.
Source: britannica

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 46) A story with two or more different meanings is called a/an -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Allegory, a symbolic fictional narrative that conveys a meaning not explicitly set forth in the narrative.
Allegory, which encompasses such forms as fable, parable, and apologue, may have meaning on two or more levels that the reader can understand only through an interpretive process.
source: britannica

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 47) Which one is a novel by Thomas Hardy?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.option2: খ) A Pair of Blue Eyes
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.option3: গ) The Return of the Native
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Thomas Hardy was a pessimistic novelist.
His famous novels: Tess of the d'urbervilles, Far from the madding crowd, The Return of the Native, The Poor Man and the Lady, the Mayor of Casterbridge, Jude the Obscure, A Pair of Blue Eyes.
Source: britannica

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 48) “Honesty is the best policy.” - who told this?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Benjamin Franklin is a USA philosopher.
His famous quotation-
- Honesty is the best policy.
- Early to bed and early to rise makes a man healthy, wealthy and wise.
- Admiration is the daughter of ignorance.
- A penny saved is a penny earned.
- Eat to live not live to eat.
source: Live MCQ archive

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 49) Who wrote the novel ‘War and peace’?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Leo Tolstoy:
One of the greatest Russian writers.
His famous works -
Novel: War and peace, Anna Karenina.
Drama: The power of Darkness.
Source: LiveMCQ Lecture

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 50) Matthew Arnold belongs to -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Matthew Arnold, English Victorian poet and literary and social critic, noted especially for his classical attacks on the contemporary tastes and manners of the “Barbarians” (the aristocracy), the “Philistines” (the commercial middle class), and the “Populace.”
Source: Britannica

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 51) W.B. Yeats achieve Nobel Prize in the year of -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
William Butler Yeats, (born June 13, 1865, Sandymount, Dublin, Ireland—died January 28, 1939, Roquebrune-Cap-Martin, France), Irish poet, dramatist, and prose writer, one of the greatest English-language poets of the 20th century.
He received the Nobel Prize for Literature in 1923.
Source: Britannica

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 52) ‘Wings of Fire’ is a/an _
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
A.P.J. Abdul Kalam, in full Avul Pakir Jainulabdeen Abdul Kalam, (born October 15, 1931, Rameswaram, India-died July 27, 2015, Shillong), Indian scientist and politician who played a leading role in the development of India's missile and nuclear weapons programs. He was president of India from 2002 to 2007. Kalam wrote several books, including an autobiography, Wings of Fire (1999).
Among his numerous awards were two of the country's highest honours, the Padma Vibhushan (1990) and the Bharat Ratna (1997).
Source: goodreads

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 53) What is the name of the autobiography written by Adolf Hitler?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
On July 18, 1925, Volume One of Adolf Hitler’s philosophical autobiography, Mein Kampf, is published.
It was a blueprint of his agenda for a Third Reich and a clear exposition of the nightmare that will envelope Europe from 1939 to 1945.
Source: history.com

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 54) Allen Ginsberg was a/an __ poet.
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Allen Ginsberg, American poet whose epic poem Howl (1956) is considered to be one of the most significant products of the Beat movement.

September on Jessore Road is a poem by Allen Ginsberg on refugees from Bangladesh Liberation war in 1971. During Bangladesh's Liberation War in 1971, the US government was an ally of Pakistan and even sent its 7th fleet to intimidate India from interfering with the events in then East Pakistan.

Source: Britannica and The New York Times.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 55) Who wrote the novel ‘A Farewell to Arms’?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
A Farewell to Arms, third novel by Ernest Hemingway, published in 1929.
A Farewell to Arms - is particularly notable for its autobiographical elements.
Source: Britannica.com

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 56) ‘The Hairy Ape’ was published in -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
The Hairy Ape, drama in eight scenes by Eugene O’Neill, produced in 1922 and published the following year. It is considered one of the prime achievements of Expressionism on stage.
The Modern Age of English Literature is considered from the year 1901 to 1939.
Source: Britannica and Live MCQ Lecture.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 57) Who wrote the play ‘Pygmalion’?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Pygmalion, romance in five acts by George Bernard Shaw, produced in German in 1913 in Vienna.
It was performed in England in 1914, with Mrs. Patrick Campbell as Eliza Doolittle. The play is a humane comedy about love and the English class system.
Source: Britannica.com

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 58) What is the real name of O’ Henry?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
O. Henry, pseudonym of William Sydney Porter, original name William Sidney Porter, (born September 11, 1862, Greensboro, North Carolina, U.S.—died June 5, 1910, New York, New York), American short-story writer whose tales romanticized the commonplace—in particular the life of ordinary people in New York City.
Source: Britannica

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 59) ‘Satanic Verses’ is written by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
The Satanic Verses, magic realist epic novel by British Indian writer Salman Rushdie that upon its publication in 1988 became one of the most controversial books in recent times.
Its fanciful and satiric use of Islam struck many Muslims as blasphemous, and Iran’s Ayatollah Ruhollah Khomeini issued a fatwa against the author in 1989, enjoining Muslims to kill not only Rushdie but also his editors and publishers. Violent demonstrations followed in Pakistan; copies of the novel were burned in Britain, where several bookstores were bombed; and the work was banned in several countries.
Source: Britannica

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 60) The Poem ‘Waste Land’ by T.S. Eliot consists How many parts?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
The Waste Land, long poem by T.S. Eliot, published in 1922, first in London in The Criterion (October), next in New York City in The Dial (November), and finally in book form, with footnotes by Eliot. The 433-line, five-part poem was dedicated to fellow poet Ezra Pound, who helped condense the original manuscript to nearly half its size. It was one of the most influential works of the 20th century.
source: Britannica

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 61) Who wrote the short story ‘The Luncheon’?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
William Somerset Maugham (1874 – 1935): Novelist, Playwright and story writer.
Works -
Novels: Of Human Bondage, The Sacred Flames, Cakes and Ale, the Magician, The Moon and Sixpence, Lady Frederick.
Play: The Land of Promise.
Short Stories: The Ant and the Grasshopper, the Luncheon.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 62) ‘A Prayer for My Daughter’ is a poem written by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
A Prayer for My Daughter is a poem written by Irish poet W. B. Yeats.
His other poems are The Cat and the Moon, The Lake Isle of Innisfree, A Full Moon in March, The Falling of the Leaves, The Second Coming, Blood and the Moon, 'Easter, 1916', Sailing to Byzantium, The Stolen Child, The Wild Swans at Coole, No Second Troy, The Green Helmet And Other Poems.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ lecture.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 63) American female novelist Pearl S. Buck got Pulitzer Prize in 1932 for the book -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Pearl S. Buck, pseudonym John Sedges, (born June 26, 1892, Hillsboro, West Virginia, U.S.—died March 6, 1973, Danby, Vermont), American author noted for her novels of life in China.
She won a Pulitzer Prize for ''The Good Earth'' in 1932, and in 1938 she became the first American woman to win the Nobel Prize for literature.
Source: Britannica and The New York Times

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 64) A sad poem remembering someone who has died refers to the term -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Elegy: A sad poem or song, especially remembering someone who has died or something in the past.
Source: Cambridge Dictionary

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 65) Which one is an example of ‘Simile’?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.option1: ক) Time flies and waits for none.
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.option2: খ) The moon is a white balloon.
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.option3: গ) The world is a stage.
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.option4: ঘ) As brave as a lion.
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Simile, figure of speech involving a comparison between two unlike entities. In the simile, unlike the metaphor, the resemblance is explicitly indicated by the words “like” or “as.”
For example: “He eats like a bird,”
“He is as smart as a whip,” etc.

Source: Britannica

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 66) “To be claimed as a good, though in an improper style, is at least better than being rejected as no good at all.” - is a famous quotation by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp: This is a famous quotation by ‘Jane Austen’ from ‘Persuasion’.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question:
67) “But I have promise to keep
and miles to go before I sleep”
Which poem these lines are taken from?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.option2: খ) Stopping by Woods on a Snowy Evening
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.option3: গ) I Wandered Lonely as a Cloud
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.option4: ঘ) Ode to the West Wind
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
"The woods are lovely, dark and deep,
But I have promises to keep,
And miles to go before I sleep,
And miles to go before I sleep."

- Stopping by Woods on a Snowy Evening
BY Robert Frost.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 68) Who was not a writer from Romantic Period?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Thomas Gray was a writer from The Age of Sensibility which belongs to The Neoclassical Period.
Some other major writers from The Age of Sensibility:
Samuel Richardson, Samuel Johnson, Henry Fielding, Oliver Goldsmith, Edmund Burke, Edward Gibbon.
Source: An ABC of English Literature - Dr M Mofizar Rahman

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 69) Which one was the first play written by Thomas Kyd?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
The English dramatist Thomas Kyd (1558-1594) is best known for ''The Spanish Tragedy,'' a play that was a great popular success and did much to influence the course of English tragedy of the late Renaissance.
Kyd probably began his career as a popular playwright about 1583 and produced his most significant work, The Spanish Tragedy, sometime between this date and 1589.
Source: biography.yourdictionary.com

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 70) A brief witty statement which is apparently self-contradictory is called -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Epigram refers to a brief and witty statement which is apparently self-contradictory.
Examples:
''Our sweetest songs are those that tell the saddest thought.''
[Shelly: ''To a Skylark'']
''The rising unto place is laborious; and by pains men come to greater pains''
[Bacon: 'of Great Place']
Source: An ABC of English Literature - Dr M Mofizar Rahman and Britannica
